Reusable audio-preprocess@2 fixture. Two encoded PCM16 WAV clips invoke the same preprocessing component and Native ONNX mean head. Component-local feature/valid-length outputs bind to independent workflow values with distinct frame dimensions. Fixture-only mel dimensions/rates are authored model data. Tests generate clips in memory and compare values, shapes, usage companions and per-clip head results. This proves CPU data flow rather than ASR or decision quality.
